rationale: AfD winning first state government since WWII shifts EU political landscape; US-Ukraine talks continue without breakthrough, war extends into winter affecting regional security and energy outlook. Score adjusted down: ongoing situation without qualitative change.

top_events.title: German far-right set for big win in eastern state, projections show
top_events.label: AfD wins first German state since WWII
top_events.summary: Far-right party projected to win over 44% in Saxony-Anhalt, marking first state government control since 1945. Shifts EU political balance and raises questions about Poland's western alliance stability.

top_events.title: Zelensky says he expects war to continue into winter after talks with US envoys
top_events.label: Ukraine war to continue into winter
top_events.summary: No breakthrough after US envoy talks in Kyiv. War extending into winter means continued energy security concerns and refugee pressure on Poland's eastern border.

top_events.title: Iran warns of 'faster, heavier, more painful response' to US attacks
top_events.label: Iran threatens escalation after US strikes
top_events.summary: Tehran warns of stronger retaliation following US strikes on oil tankers. Continued Middle East tension sustains elevated fuel prices affecting Polish transport and heating costs.

short_summary: Trump envoys visit Moscow and Kyiv for talks

most_significant_event.label: Trump envoys visit Moscow and Kyiv for talks
most_significant_event.summary: US peace envoys travel to Moscow and Kyiv this weekend attempting to restart stalled Russia-Ukraine negotiations, offering potential shift in war affecting Poland's eastern border.
